title: Bayesian Updating: Prior, Likelihood & Posterior
interviewAnswer: Bayesian inference updates prior beliefs with evidence through the likelihood to produce a posterior distribution. The posterior represents uncertainty about parameters after observing data.
keyPoints: Posterior predictive checks validate consequences of the model.
why: Bayesian Updating: Prior, Likelihood & Posterior appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: Bayesian inference updates prior beliefs with evidence through the likelihood to produce a posterior distribution. The posterior represents uncertainty about parameters after observing data. Priors can regularize sparse/noisy problems. Posterior predictive checks validate consequences of the model. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Update a prior conversion-rate distribution after observing new experiment successes/failures.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
